messages.content: I just lost my job and I feel like a failure.

Losing a job is a real blow, and the feelings you're having — including that sense of failure — are completely human. But it doesn't define your worth or your future. Many people who've been in exactly this position have gone on to build something better. What happened, if you feel like sharing?
